Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads

While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to command Starblazer to attack enemies.

Trailblaze Never Ends

By Your Side

Skill DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova is considered as Ultimate DMG.
Off-Field Trailblaze Companion characters can also use an Assist Skill when taking action, and King Pom-Pom is also considered as a Trailblaze Companion character.
